NIGHT MARKET TOUR REVENUE SHARE AGREEMENT

This Revenue Share Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into by and between Ada Obi, Tunde Bakare and Chioma Eze (each a "Party" and together the "Parties") in connection with the live concert series known as the Night Market Tour (the "Tour").

1. Term

1.1 This Agreement starts on March 1, 2026 and ends on February 28, 2027, unless the Parties agree in writing to extend it.

2. Revenue

2.1 "Gross Receipts" means all ticket, merchandise and streaming income actually received from the Tour.

2.2 "Net Revenue" means Gross Receipts less payment processing fees charged by the payment provider.

2.3 Payment processing fees are deducted from Gross Receipts before the split.

3. Advance

3.1 Ada Obi received a $2,000 advance to cover rehearsal space, which is recouped from Net Revenue before the split.

3.2 Once the advance has been recouped in full, no further amount is owed in respect of it.

4. Revenue Shares

4.1 Ada Obi receives 50% of Net Revenue.

4.2 Tunde Bakare receives 30% of Net Revenue.

4.3 Chioma Eze receives 20% of Net Revenue.

4.4 Each Party's share is calculated monthly and paid within fifteen (15) days of the end of each calendar month.

5. Refunds

5.1 Refunds issued to ticket buyers are deducted from Gross Receipts before the split.

6. Currency

6.1 All amounts under this Agreement are in USD.

7. General

7.1 This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties about the Tour and replaces any earlier discussions.

7.2 Any change to this Agreement must be in writing and approved by every Party.

Signed by Ada Obi, Tunde Bakare and Chioma Eze.
